locations.label: Tombs Mural
locations.description: First obtain the monocle from the first shock mimic. Then shoot aetheric lanterns (and wait for them to respawn) until one is opposite the mural on the left side. Then shoot the lit symbols in order (roman numerals) to trigger a lockdown. The reward is 1 of 2 ice staff parts.

locations.label: Caves Mural
locations.description: First obtain the monocle from the first shock mimic. Then shoot aetheric lanterns (and wait for them to respawn) until one is opposite the mural. Then shoot the lit symbols in order (roman numerals) to trigger a lockdown. The reward is 1 of 2 ice staff parts.

locations.label: Nexus Altar
locations.description: Take the ice staff parts here and interact with it to trigger a defend event. Stop the staff being destroyed and you'll earn the base ice staff.

locations.label: Floating Rocks
locations.description: Look above this Dark Aether Nexus area for the floating symbol rocks after the Ice Staff lantern challenge. The area marker does not pinpoint all three airborne rocks.

locations.label: Purple Orb
locations.description: Dark Aether Nexus escort reference. The closed gateway is selected by the current attempt; use the three rock symbols at its outside face, then escort the orb inside. This is not a guaranteed gateway location.
locations.conditions: Possible location; the active spawn or chosen site depends on the current run.

locations.label: Vermin Crystal
locations.description: The pillar needs to be charged by completing a trial associated with the statue in front of it. Each statue will have a coloured crystal appear one after another, they can be initiated by shooting the crystal with the healing beam (alt fire) from the upgraded ice staff. The colour corresponds to the door where you can find the podium for the trial. The first one is blue/vermin.

locations.label: Vermin Podium
locations.description:
This is the podium associated with the one in the dark aether. Each will have a statue of the special enemy associated with it. After completing the lockdown you need to take the energy from the podium back to the associated pillar in the aether. Try not to get hit.
Located in Dig Site.

locations.label: Parasite Podium
locations.description:
This is the podium associated with the one in the dark aether. Each will have a statue of the special enemy associated with it. After completing the lockdown you need to take the energy from the podium back to the associated pillar in the aether. Try not to get hit.

targets.title: Nexus gateways & Pack-a-Punch positions
targets.description: Dig Site → Subterranean Temple pedestal → open and enter Dark Aether Nexus.

targets.title: Perks & upgrade services
targets.description: Prepare armor/bullet damage; learn blue spawn, yellow Shrine, green Ossuary and red Temple portals.

targets.title: Bull mural
targets.description: Tombs lantern faces bull → shoot I–VIII → five-wave defense → Staff piece.

targets.title: Archer mural
targets.description: Catacombs lantern by Crafting Table → shoot I–X → five-wave defense → Head Piece.

targets.title: Nexus Staff altar
targets.description: Nexus central altar → protect forming Staff → collect Staff of Ice.

targets.title: Floating symbol-rock search area
targets.description: Staff-shoot three marked Nexus rocks; record all three glyphs.

targets.title: Nexus orb escort reference
targets.description: All players follow and feed the orb → central altar interaction → Ull’s Arrow.

targets.title: Vermin Nexus statue → map podium
targets.description: Vermin: Nexus → Dig Site defense → safe return → Nexus Vermin deposit.

targets.title: Parasite Nexus statue → map podium
targets.description: Parasite: Shrine trial → kill purple Parasites, collect and deposit orbs → return charge.

targets.title: Doppelghast Nexus statue → map podium
targets.description: Doppelghast: Ossuary defense; avoid spike circles → carry charge home.

targets.title: Amalgam Nexus statue → map podium
targets.description: Amalgam: Deep Excavation; kill shield-tether zombies → finish HVT → return charge.

targets.title: Sentinel Artifact encounter entrance
targets.description: Four statue beams → bridge; prepare PaP III legendary bullet weapon and survival supplies.

targets.title: Two statue-head containers
targets.description: Two Nexus crates → heads onto Dig Site / Mausoleum statues.

targets.title: Golden Armor reward
targets.description: Both sacrifices complete → free Golden Armor wall-buy for each player.

targets.title: Four shovel locations
targets.description: Shovels: Tombs pillar; Ossuary skull pile; central waterfall arch; right of Quick Revive.

targets.title: Published dig-site locations
targets.description: Death Perception + shovel → three Ancient Gems → bull-mural statue → defeat Doppelghasts.

targets.title: Two frozen-waterfall targets
targets.description: Freeze both Nexus waterfalls → rarity tool; wait to round 11/21 for a better tier.

targets.title: Floating-rock reward area
targets.description: Shoot sparking Nexus rock → quickly hit all spawned rocks → PaP crystal and Cryofreeze.

targets.title: Music headphones
targets.description: After Staff: shoot 1, 1, 5 on both constellation murals → “Aether.”

targets.title: Hidden power-up models
targets.description: Find seven hidden power-up models; collect them to unlock the Dig Site Fire Sale.

targets.title: Services & Nexus gateways
targets.description: Use Dig Site/Deep Excavation Arsenals and Nexus portals to shorten resupply trips.
